description:
TweetEval-Annotated Dataset
	

TweetEval-Annotated is a crowdsourced annotation set built from the emoji recognition task in TweetEval.
It contains the source label from TweetEval, the reference annotation label used in this dataset, four human annotations, and an optional LLM annotation.
